text:
deploy-bot: Started staged rollout: service=inference-api version=v2026.03.18 -> prod canary=3% (eu-west, us-east). change_window=03/19 02:00-04:00 UTC. rollout_id=rl-20260319-01

alice.h: ack. watching metrics for first 15m. @maria_ops can you monitor eu-west p99 + errors?

sam_platform: good to call out KV cache and cold-starts in the runbook. dashboard -> https://dash.redwood.internal/r/inference-api/rollouts/rl-20260319-01

maria_ops: seeing p99 tail increase in eu-west already, ~+120ms vs baseline, error rate still low (0.07%) but some 504s in the last 30s. holding eyeballs. @leo_oncall pls check pod restarts

leo_oncall: checking now, no restarts, but I see a few requests hitting slow upstream:
```
2026-03-19T02:10:05Z inference-api[pod-7f9]: GET /v1/generate took 850ms status=200 route=/api/generate
2026-03-19T02:10:12Z inference-api[pod-3b2]: GET /v1/generate took 920ms status=504 upstream_timeout
```

ben.k: hmm. is this the new quantized kernel path? any backend kernel logs?

maria_ops: looks correlated with KV cache misses on hosts that just received traffic. p99 spikes on first requests after new pod spin-up. I recommend pausing ramp to 3% steady and not increase to 10% until we warm caches.

alice.h: agree. HOLD the ramp. do not proceed to 10%. we should pin EU traffic to previous version for safety while we warm caches. command to pin: `deployctl pin inference-api --version=v2026.03.17 --region=eu-west`

deploy-bot: Received hold: rollout rl-20260319-01 paused by @alice.h. Auto-ramp disabled.

ben.k: I'll run a quick warmup: `/opt/tools/warmup --service inference-api --region eu-west --concurrency 4 --duration 90s` to populate KV caches. Will post results.

sam_platform: alternative option if warmup isn't enough: route eu-west 100% to model-compat fallback `inference-api@compat-v2026.03.17` until we have a patch. That requires a short pin, then we can try a microbake for the new image.

leo_oncall: started warmup, logs: 
```
[02:14:10] warmup: hit /v1/generate 200 OK latency=110ms
[02:14:30] warmup: hit /v1/generate 200 OK latency=98ms
[02:15:40] warmup: hit /v1/generate 200 OK latency=105ms
```
Warmup reduced tail on those pods.

maria_ops: nice. I've set an alert: `if p99_eu > 400ms for 3m OR errors > 0.5% for 1m -> incident channel` and dashboard annotated the rollout.

alice.h: decision: keep rollout paused at 3% global, pin eu-west to v2026.03.17 for safety right now, run warmup across remaining canary pods, then re-run a microbake to test kernel path with cache warmed. If any error spike >0.5% or p99 >400ms we rollback to v2026.03.17 globally.

deploy-bot: Action taken: pinned inference-api -> v2026.03.17 in eu-west. rollout rl-20260319-01 paused. notes: "hold: cache-cold p99 tail" created.

ben.k: running extended warmup for remaining hosts, will report in 10m. :thumbsup:

maria_ops: monitoring window tightened to 1m. will report back. thanks all.

alice.h: I'll update release notes and ops-runbook: add "post-deploy cache warmup step" and mention pinning action. @sam_platform please prepare a microbake build with an added KV prefetch flag for testing.

sam_platform: on it, creating branch kv-warmup-flag and will push a canary image tag `v2026.03.18-kvprefetch` for a small smoke later.

leo_oncall: no further 504s in last 2m after warmup on warmed pods. holding until warmup completes for all.

(END)
